subject: Application: Junior Draftsperson, DOF Perth, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Junior Draftsperson role with DOF in Perth CBD, closing 15 October 2026, via your Workable advert.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design documented in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Perth. My drafting is from study rather than paid Australian commercial work, and I have not yet worked on offshore or subsea packages, so I would learn those standards under your Lead Draftsperson.

Your advert asks for an Advanced Diploma path into 2D technical drawings with AutoCAD under mentoring, which is the junior drafting step I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application: Junior Draftsperson
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Draftsperson role with DOF in the Perth CBD Engineering and Drafting team, advertised on Workable and closing 15 October 2026. The role reports to the Lead Draftsperson and focuses on 2D technical drawings, drafting packages and drawing quality under mentoring.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards, Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates and bills of quantities. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering at Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project in charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with inspections, procurement tracking and progress reports.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Perth. I have not yet used Autodesk Vault or worked on offshore or subsea drafting packages, so those would be new learning with your team. My AutoCAD drafting experience is from study, not a paid Australian commercial role.
I have attached my resume. I would like to contribute to accurate 2D drawings while building drafting skill in your Perth team. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
